demoChecklist.title: Testnet Demo Runbook
demoChecklist.subtitle: Pre-demo, live-demo, and post-demo checklists for the Soter Testnet deployment. Includes failure recovery and canonical contract references.
demoChecklist.allComplete: All steps completed — the demo flow checks out!
demoChecklist.stepConnectWalletDesc: Open the homepage and click "Connect Freighter Wallet" in the navbar. Approve the connection in the Freighter extension popup. Make sure Freighter is set to Testnet.
demoChecklist.stepViewCampaignDesc: Navigate to the Campaigns page and open an active campaign. Verify that campaign details, budget, and status are displayed correctly.
demoChecklist.stepSubmitClaimDesc: From a campaign detail page or the home verification flow, submit a claim using sample evidence text. Confirm the claim submission succeeds and you see a confirmation.
demoChecklist.stepVerifyReceiptDesc: Open the claim receipt page and verify the receipt shows the correct claim ID, package ID, amount, and on-chain status. Confirm the receipt can be shared or downloaded.
demoChecklist.preDemoSubtitle: Complete these checks before starting the demo to ensure everything is wired correctly.
demoChecklist.preSystemHealthDesc: Confirm the /health endpoint returns status=ok and that service, version, and environment labels are populated.
demoChecklist.preNetworkConfigDesc: Verify NEXT_PUBLIC_STELLAR_NETWORK is set to testnet. RPC URL should be https://soroban-testnet.stellar.org:443 and network passphrase should match Test SDF Network.
demoChecklist.preContractRegistryDesc: Verify the contract ID in Contract Registry panel matches the backend env AID_ESCROW_CONTRACT_ID. Source of truth: deployments/contract-registry.json generated by generate-registry.py.
demoChecklist.preWalletConnectDesc: Open homepage, connect wallet, confirm network indicator shows Testnet and that the public key starts with G. Switch Freighter network if needed.
demoChecklist.preFaucetFunding: Top up wallet with Testnet XLM
demoChecklist.preFaucetFundingDesc: Use the Testnet Faucet Helper (bottom-right) to request 10,000 XLM. Confirm balance is non-zero before any on-chain actions. Base reserve requirement is ~1 XLM.
demoChecklist.preBackendSmoke: Run backend smoke test via Dashboard
demoChecklist.preBackendSmokeDesc: Navigate to Dashboard and confirm summary cards (total claims, packages, pending reviews, disbursements) render non-zero values from the /analytics/global-stats endpoint.
demoChecklist.liveDemoSubtitle: Execute the demo flow step-by-step. For each step, narrate what you are showing and confirm the expected behavior.
demoChecklist.liveCampaignBrowseDesc: Open Campaigns list. Select an active campaign, open the detail view. Show the budget progress bar, recipient count, status badge, and recipient import wizard if present.
demoChecklist.liveClaimSubmitDesc: From the claim flow, select a package, enter sample recipient details, and upload mock evidence (text or photo). Confirm the verification queue receives the new entry.
demoChecklist.liveVerificationReview: Review and approve a verification request
demoChecklist.liveVerificationReviewDesc: Open Verification Review queue. Select a pending_review item. Review the evidence panel, add an internal note, click Approve, confirm status transitions to approved.
demoChecklist.liveOnchainReceiptDesc: Open the claim receipt page for the recently approved claim. Show that receipt includes package ID, amount, on-chain status, and a Stellar Explorer link. Verify the transaction hash is present.
demoChecklist.liveDashboardMetricsDesc: Navigate back to Dashboard. Point out that the disbursement count increased by 1 after the claim above. Refresh and show that system health badge stays green.
demoChecklist.postDemoSubtitle: Tear down, preserve data, and document findings after the demo concludes.
demoChecklist.postDataCleanupDesc: Remove temporary internal notes added during the walkthrough. Delete any test-only campaigns or packages created for the demo. Reset any verification-inbox statuses that were only for the walkthrough.
demoChecklist.postLedgerReconcile: Reconcile off-chain state with on-chain ledger
demoChecklist.postLedgerReconcileDesc: Run ledger reconciliation service to compare backend package/claim records with on-chain contract state. Flag any discrepancies (orphaned packages, unprocessed claim events) for triage.
demoChecklist.postStateExportDesc: Export dashboard summary CSV. Download the deployment runbook registry snapshot. Save browser console logs and network HAR if debugging was needed. Store in the shared demo artifacts folder.
demoChecklist.postDebriefNotesDesc: Record: which steps succeeded, which steps had issues, any failure-recovery actions taken, audience questions, and follow-up action items with owners and due dates.
demoChecklist.recoverySubtitle: Common Testnet issues encountered during demos. Click an issue to reveal the step-by-step recovery procedure.
demoChecklist.issueRpcTimeoutSymptom: RPC endpoint returns connection refused, timeout, or failed to connect.
demoChecklist.issueRpcTimeoutCause: Public Soroban RPC endpoint is unreachable; network firewall or proxy blocking requests; wrong RPC path configured.
demoChecklist.issueRateLimitSymptom: HTTP 429 Too Many Requests, service unavailable, or intermittent acks from RPC.
demoChecklist.issueRateLimitCause: Public RPC rate limiting triggered during high-traffic demo or repeated polling.
demoChecklist.issueXlmSymptom: Transaction fails with insufficient balance, account not found on Horizon, or operations return underfunded.
demoChecklist.issueXlmCause: Testnet wallet has insufficient XLM to cover base reserve + transaction fees + contract storage deposits.
demoChecklist.issueStaleLedgerSymptom: Timeout waiting for ledger, data appears stale after successful write, or query returns old state.
demoChecklist.issueStaleLedgerCause: RPC provider is lagging; testnet ledger is not fully synced to the node; local cache has not invalidated.
demoChecklist.issueContractMismatchSymptom: On-chain actions target wrong Contract ID, package not found on chain, or disburse operations fail with unknown contract.
demoChecklist.issueContractMismatchCause: Backend or frontend still points to an old/archived Contract ID from a previous deployment that was redeployed without updating all downstream systems.
demoChecklist.issueWalletMismatchSymptom: Freighter shows different network than expected, transactions fail with wrong network, or wallet connection shows Mainnet instead of Testnet.
demoChecklist.issueWalletMismatchCause: Freighter wallet is configured for Mainnet or Futurenet instead of the Testnet environment the demo is running against.
demoChecklist.registrySubtitle: Source of truth for deployed contract IDs, versions, and network mappings. Generated by the onchain scripts and consumed by backend + frontend.
demoChecklist.registryNoDeployments: No deployments recorded for this network yet.
